name: release
description: Automate semantic versioning releases: pull latest code, detect changes since the last semver tag, generate a human-readable CHANGELOG.md, bump the version, update version in package.json and similar files, commit, and tag. Supports pre-release versions (alpha, beta, rc). Use this skill whenever the user wants to cut a release, tag a version, create a changelog, bump a version number, prepare a release, or says things like "release", "new version", "tag a release", "cut a release", "prepare release", "publish version", "changelog", "pre-release", "release candidate", "beta release", "alpha release". Also triggers for "what changed since last release" if followed by intent to release.
